Real modbit-core, real fixture actuator process, real approvals, real git and sleep commands and a scripted model alternating commands and interface actions: every step is one observation record (tool, kind, status, frame, snapshot, accessibility delta, stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout, truncation); output past the bound ends with the marker; a command that times out is an error record and the child goes on to a COMPLETED envelope; the records are in the logged result objects. limitations: A command step does not re-read the interface: its frame and snapshot are the last the child saw and its tree_delta is null. A state delta is a line-set comparison.
